_comment: The lab host's (L) sanitizer records of the H5(c) HTTP/2 evidence, read by analysis/macros_review.py (h5_http2), which sets \HFiveHttpTwoState: 0 while any record is pending, 1 when every record of the fix commit is green, 2 when one is red. A record marked green or red must be the named file in lab/sanitizer-records, and its own 'green' field must agree. The earlier commit's outcomes come from results/README.md, 'H5(c) over HTTP/2' (its red record stays on L, not committed). To finish H5(c): set each status and record name, then run analysis/macros.py again.
